        <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">mkhan chen <expan>pa</expan></rs><expan>'i</expan> phyag dpe 'di |  <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5284">dbyang dpal</rs> gyi legs par bris pa 'di dge zhing <expan>bkra shis</expan> par 'gyur gcig || shub+haM || || ||</seg></TEI>
